name: MJ Lenderman
label: Anti-
lede: He scooped ice cream in Asheville, played lead guitar in Wednesday, and made a record that Pitchfork ranked fourth best of 2024.

eras.title: A kid from Asheville with a sticker-covered Squier
eras.text: Mark Jacob Lenderman, known to everyone as Jake, grows up in Asheville, North Carolina, takes up guitar young, and falls in with the UNC Asheville house-show crowd. Wednesday starts up in the same scene before he joins it.

years.src: Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman · The Ringer: MJ Lenderman, Indie Rock's No. 1 Prospect · Guitar.com: How MJ Lenderman embraced exploding guitar solos · Indy Week: Interview: MJ Lenderman
years.h: Mark Jacob Lenderman is born in Asheville
years.p: His parents had moved to Asheville from Virginia in 1993. By seven he was hooked on Guitar Hero, which led to lessons and a rock summer camp.
years.xp:
His first guitar was a sticker-covered sunburst Squier Stratocaster, he told Guitar.com, and at nine or ten he found [[Dinosaur Jr.|77c167d2-4965-4421-830a-9815e4956475]] through his father's copy of Farm. At that summer camp he met Ethan Baechtold, who would later play bass in Wednesday.

He played basketball hard through middle school and early high school, until he lost interest in coaches who, in his words, "tried to beat you down." The sport never left his songs.

years.src: Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band) · The Ringer: Wednesday's Teenage Dirtbag Hymnals
years.p: It began as her solo project, then became a duo with Daniel Gorham on the self-released yep definitely (January 31, 2018).
years.xp:
The lineup came together through the DIY house-show scene around UNC Asheville, where Hartzman, who grew up in Greensboro, met Lenderman, drummer Alan Miller and pedal steel player Xandy Chelmis, according to The Ringer.

Wikipedia lists Gorham as leaving in 2019 for Prince Daddy & the Hyena.

eras.title: Ice cream, Bandcamp, and a roommates' record
eras.text: Lenderman scoops ice cream by day, posts lo-fi records on Bandcamp, and becomes Wednesday's lead guitarist. By spring 2022 a Dear Life Records album full of wrestlers and hangovers is on year-end lists everywhere.

years.src: Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman · Stereogum: MJ Lenderman Is Knockin' On Rock Stardom's Door
years.h: The self-titled debut arrives while he scoops ice cream
years.p: MJ Lenderman came out June 15, 2019 on Bandcamp and Dear Life Records, the Asheville label that would release his next three solo albums.
years.xp:
He worked at an ice cream shop from high school and kept the job into his twenties. "It's the only job I could tour with," he told Stereogum.

Wikipedia dates the release June 15 but also files it under July in its career narrative; we use the release date.

years.cap: Wednesday with Lenderman on lead guitar.
years.src: Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band) · Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman · The Ringer: Wednesday's Teenage Dirtbag Hymnals · Variety: Wednesday Singer Karly Hartzman
years.h: Wednesday gets a lead guitarist, then the pandemic hits
years.p: Lenderman toured with the band in early 2020, just before shows stopped. By Twin Plagues (August 13, 2021, Orindal Records) he was a full member.
years.xp:
Wikipedia's Wednesday entry dates his tenure from 2020, and The Ringer has him a full member by Twin Plagues. His own Wikipedia page says he joined in 2018; we show 2020 as the start.

Hartzman told Variety how the trade worked: he writes his guitar parts for Wednesday, and he teaches her guitar parts for his songs.

years.src: Wikipedia: Ghost of Your Guitar Solo
years.h: Ghost of Your Guitar Solo: ten songs, 25 minutes, written with roommates
years.p: Released March 26, 2021 on Dear Life. Colin Miller and Lewis Dahm play on the closer, "Live Jack."
years.xp:
Wikipedia says the record grew out of daily writing exercises and jam sessions with his housemates, then got sanded down into songs. Vinyl and CD followed in May 2023, with cover art by Jon Samuels, after the live album sent listeners back to it.

It opens with its longest track, the 4:45 title song, and several tracks in the middle run under two minutes.

q: The less people hear me talk, the more they can project on me.
years.src: Wikipedia: Boat Songs · Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman · Indy Week: Interview: MJ Lenderman
years.p: Released April 29, 2022 on Dear Life and recorded at Drop of Sun with Alex Farrar. Pitchfork's Sasha Geffen gave it 8.3.
years.xp:
Two singles set it up: "Hangover Game" in January and "TLC Cage Match" in March. Stereogum's Chris DeVille compared him to Jason Molina, Uncle Tupelo and Pinegrove. The record landed on year-end lists at Pitchfork, the A.V. Club, Rolling Stone and The Ringer, and placed as high as No. 4 on The Alternative's top 50.

He kept his distance from the hype.

years.src: Wikipedia: Bull Believer · Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band)
years.h: Wednesday's "Bull Believer" runs 8:30 and signs them to Dead Oceans
years.p: Hartzman's bullfighting-and-addiction epic was recorded at Drop of Sun, and the band signed to Dead Oceans on the last day of recording. The song was released September 8, 2022.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says the first half draws on a Cocaine & Rhinestones episode about George Jones and bullfighting, and the second half on Hartzman's memory of a friend who died when she was seventeen. She has said it was about the third time she had screamed in her life; the rest of the band played Tetris in another part of the studio during the take.

Pitchfork put it at No. 92 on its 2022 best songs list.

eras.title: Anti- and the Wednesday breakthrough
eras.text: Anti- signs him, with help from a Crutchfield; Wednesday's Rat Saw God becomes the year's most-talked-about Asheville record; a live album bottles what the band sounds like on stage.

years.big: "Like talking to somebody who was already a friend"
years.src: Stereogum: MJ Lenderman Is Knockin' On Rock Stardom's Door · NME: MJ Lenderman on resisting the hype · Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman
years.h: Anti- wins him over with a phone call
years.p: That is how Lenderman described A&R Allison Crutchfield, sister of [[Waxahatchee|42321e24-42b6-4f08-b0d9-8325ee887a20]]'s Katie Crutchfield, when he explained to Stereogum why he picked Anti-.
years.xp:
Boat Songs had done the work: Wikipedia's account has him signing to Anti- in 2022 after the record's reception. NME notes the Crutchfield link and quotes him calling the team "really open and understanding."

Dear Life Records had put out his first three solo albums; Anti- has handled everything since.

years.src: The Ringer: Wednesday's Teenage Dirtbag Hymnals · Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band) · Wikipedia: Bull Believer
years.h: Wednesday, Rat Saw God: Hartzman's high school, Lenderman's guitar
years.p: Released April 7, 2023 on Dead Oceans. Hartzman wrote from her own memories and local legends; Lenderman supplied the lead guitar.
years.xp:
The Ringer reported that Hartzman got permission from the people whose stories she used, including her uncle. "Chosen to Deserve" is about the two bandmates' own relationship, and "Formula One" is about their pandemic rituals.

At Primavera Sound Barcelona on June 4, 2023, Hartzman gave an anti-Amazon speech before "Bull Believer," which she dedicated to mistreated warehouse workers.

years.src: Wikipedia: And the Wind (Live and Loose!) · Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman
years.h: And the Wind (Live and Loose!) is a first Anti- release, live
years.p: Released November 17, 2023: 15 songs culled from Lincoln Hall in Chicago and the Lodge Room in Los Angeles. Metacritic has it at 82.
years.xp:
The Chicago show was a Pitchfork Music Festival afterparty. Pitchfork's Arielle Gordon wrote that he turns his dreamlike narratives into something "joyous, collective, and free."

The band behind him, the Wind, is Colin Miller on drums, Landon George on bass, Xandy Chelmis on pedal steel, Ethan Baechtold on keys and Jon Samuels on guitar.

eras.title: Manning Fireworks
eras.text: The year he goes from the best-kept secret in Asheville to a name on everyone's list, with a 38-minute record made at Drop of Sun, the Asheville studio where Wednesday and Indigo De Souza also record.

years.src: Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman · Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band) · Year-End Lists: Pitchfork 50 Best Albums of 2024
years.h: He plays guitar and sings on Waxahatchee's Tigers Blood
years.p: Lenderman is on Katie Crutchfield's album and on the single "Right Back to It." Pitchfork ranked Tigers Blood No. 6 of 2024, two spots behind his own.
years.xp:
Crutchfield's sister Allison is the A&R person who signed him to Anti-.

In the same month, Wikipedia reports, he and Hartzman ended their six-year relationship while touring in Tokyo. The news became public in July. They kept working together, and Hartzman sings backing vocals on "She's Leaving You."

years.src: Wikipedia: She's Leaving You · NPR: MJ Lenderman joins rock and roll's lineage of heartbreak kids
years.h: "She's Leaving You" gets a talent-show video
years.p: The lead single, released June 24, 2024, came with a video by Clay Tatum and Whitmer Thomas set at a talent show, with cheerleaders and magicians.
years.xp:
Critics compared the video to "Smells Like Teen Spirit" and the film Drop Dead Gorgeous. Wikipedia describes the song as a tragicomic portrait of a man caught lying after a bender in Vegas.

NPR's review of the album said the record came out of a hard year in which both the band and Lenderman's solo star were on the rise.

years.src: Wikipedia: Manning Fireworks · Guitar.com: How MJ Lenderman embraced exploding guitar solos · Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman
years.h: Manning Fireworks: nine songs, one ten-minute closer
years.p: Released September 6, 2024 on Anti-. Pitchfork's Jeremy D. Larson gave it 8.7 and Best New Music, then ranked it No. 4 of 2024 behind Cindy Lee, Charli XCX and Jessica Pratt.
years.xp:
Lenderman and Alex Farrar produced it at Drop of Sun Studios in Asheville, where he played guitar, bass, drums, organ and drone. He told Guitar.com he was thinking about hooks and direct melodies this time. The exploding guitar solos on "Wristwatch," "On My Knees" and "Rudolph" are what he called "kind of an explosion."

Wednesday's Hartzman, Chelmis and Baechtold are on it, plus Landon George, Shane McCord on clarinet and Colin Miller on slide guitar. It closes with the 10:00 "Bark at the Moon." Singles: "She's Leaving You," "Joker Lips" (July 29) and "Wristwatch" (September 4).

Metacritic has it at 88. The New Yorker named it the best album of 2024. Pitchfork's December 3 list also had Nala Sinephro, Waxahatchee, Mount Eerie, Bladee, Astrid Sonne and Kim Gordon in the top 10. Stereogum, Brooklyn Vegan and The Line of Best Fit put it second. Rolling Stone and Pitchfork had it in their top five, Wikipedia reports.

years.src: Stereogum: MJ Lenderman Postpones Tour Dates · WUNC: Why Asheville's Drop of Sun Studios · Wikipedia: Manning Fireworks
years.h: Hurricane Helene knocks out the first tour dates
years.p: His Manning Fireworks tour kickoff in Atlanta and Nashville was postponed after Helene flooded western North Carolina, where most of the band and their families live.
years.xp:
Stereogum reported the first show moved to Knoxville that Sunday. Indigo De Souza, who also lives near Asheville, wrote that her house was completely flooded.

Drop of Sun, where the record was made, later helped raise $145,000 in artist grants through the nonprofit Lamplight AVL, according to WUNC. Lenderman was one of 135 artists on a hurricane-relief compilation.

eras.title: Off the road, still in the band
eras.text: Lenderman steps back from touring with Wednesday, plays late-night TV with the Wind, and turns up in a surprise supergroup.

years.src: Consequence: MJ Lenderman Brings Joker Lips to Kimmel · Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band) · Wikipedia: Bleeds (Wednesday album)
years.h: Kimmel gets "Joker Lips"; Wednesday gets a touring hiatus
years.p: On February 12, 2025, Lenderman and the Wind played "Joker Lips" on Jimmy Kimmel Live!, in front of a backdrop from the album's hand-painted art.
years.xp:
Consequence reported he added eye rolls for lyrics that could not be sung on network TV. Also in February, Wikipedia reports, he announced he would step back from touring with Wednesday while remaining "a full contributing member" in the studio.

Jake "Spyder" Pugh has filled in on lead guitar on the road. Wednesday's Bleeds (September 19, 2025, Dead Oceans, produced by Alex Farrar at Drop of Sun) still features Lenderman.

years.h: [[Snocaps|5396d542-5270-4bbf-bd25-4ab0208d0541]] appears out of nowhere on Halloween
years.p: Katie and Allison Crutchfield, Brad Cook and Lenderman dropped a self-titled debut on Anti- on October 31, 2025, with no warning.
years.xp: It is the Crutchfield sisters' first joint album since their P.S. Eliot days, and Wikipedia credits Lenderman as a full member. Reviewers called it headstrong, tender Americana.
